name: Steelslender
description: Bow with the point lowered to the floor, then rise into a levelled guard that frames the opponent.

name: Thunderclap Squaretip
description: Answer the salute with a straight thrust at the opponent's chest, aimed with the whole forearm.

name: Twilit Hardtip
description: Glide forward across the practice floor in even paces that keep the point level and unmoving.

name: Delugestrait
description: Beat the opposing blade aside, then pair the beat with a second from the other side to clear the line.

name: Ruling Pierce
description: Lock blades at the cross and hold them there while the free foot steps round to the flank.

name: Pealtaut
description: Gauge the exact distance to the opponent by lightly touching blades and reading how far the point can reach.

name: Steel Bracespine
description: Send two points along one line a breath apart, the first opening the guard and the second entering it.

name: Prismtaut
description: Lift the blade into the opponent's thrust and turn its force back up the line of its own approach.

name: Pulsarbore
description: Pass through the court in a flash of qi and leave the point already placed in the opponent's guard.

name: Imperial Vacuum Skewer
description: Gather the court's two tracks into one final thrust that the school teaches as the close of every bout.

name: Steel Trianglespine
description: Hold the point and the free hand at opposite ends of a shallow circle, ready to turn either way.

name: Splendid Squarepoint
description: Thrust from the rim of the circle toward its centre, the opponent's chest being the centre.

name: Vigor Thrustspine
description: Step once along the circle and once across it so the opponent loses track of the point.

name: Squall Longtang
description: Slide the opponent's blade along the rim of the guard and off its end past the wrist.

name: Revelation Stiffspine
description: Read both of the opponent's hands at once, one eye for the weapon hand and one for the guard.

name: Sigil Rigidtang
description: Bind the opposing blade in the first basin and hold it while the point turns into the second.

name: Vacuum Gouge
description: Corkscrew the point along a short spiral so that it enters the guard from an unexpected angle.

name: Borevow
description: Dip the point into a shallow circle to draw the opponent's blade down, then thrust over it.

name: Imperious Stiffblade
description: Press the point and the pommel hand together toward the opponent's centre until their stance cannot hold.

name: Phantasm Rigidtang
description: Turn the blade like a still pool's surface so a thrust is mirrored back toward its source.

name: Animaimpale
description: Turn two basins of qi against each other along the blade and drive their meeting point past any armor.

name: Storied Stiffspine Triumph
description: Spin two interlocked spirals of qi down the blade into one closing thrust, the school's mark of mastery.

name: Steeltaut
description: Stand at the bank of the courtyard with the point downstream and the weight on the back foot.

name: Unrivaled Drill
description: Thrust along the line of the river through the court, never bending from its course.

name: Delugeskewer
description: Pace along the edge of the guard as the river runs along its bank, keeping the point turned inward.

name: Interstice Hardtip
description: Feel the opponent's pressure as a current through the blade and learn where it runs fastest.

name: Mighty Longtang
description: Hold the opposing blade in a small eddy of turning pressure until its owner cannot free it.

name: Paramount Impale
description: Race the point down the opponent's blade as a current races down a narrow channel.

name: Windborne Drill
description: Slip along the opponent's side like water round a stone and return to guard at their rear flank.

name: Solarslender
description: Let loose a flood of fast thrusts that spreads across every opponent standing in the courtyard.

name: Squaretip Seal
description: Set the blade against the current of a strike and send it running back the way it came.

name: Bore Triumph
description: Gather a torrent of qi behind the blade and loose it through the point in one irresistible run.

name: Thunderclap Trianglespine
description: Draw all the court's currents into one last thrust, taught by the school as the river reaching the sea.

name: Titan Bracespine
description: Raise the point high in a hawk's salute and bring it down to a guard that watches the whole opponent.

name: Pulsar Impale
description: Thrust from above the shoulder at the opponent's throat, falling like a hawk upon a hare.

name: Bedrock Pierce
description: Glide in low and quiet paces across the court as a hawk glides above a field.

name: Deluge Squarepoint
description: Strike the opposing blade downward with a short sharp beat, as a hawk strikes a bird from the air.

name: Eclipse Squaretip
description: Fix a steady gaze on the opponent's centre and notice every shift in weight from above.

name: Millstone Thrustspine
description: Clamp the crossguard over the opposing blade like a talon and press it to the ground.

name: Prism Stiffblade
description: Stoop from a high guard and thrust downward at the shoulder gap while the opponent is still rising.

name: Straitvow
description: Hover the point above the opponent's guard as if undecided, then drop it to the opposite side.

name: Radiance Skewer
description: Dive with the body's whole weight and a surge of qi behind the point to break through the guard.

name: Bedrock Gouge
description: Circle the point high above the head and drop it in turn upon each opponent within reach.

name: Pulsarslender
description: Vanish from a high guard in a bolt of qi and strike with the point in the same instant.

name: Noble Longtang
description: Gather the whole court's hunting patience into one master stoop that the school ends every lesson with.

name: Searing Thrustspine
description: Stand upright beneath the open sky with the point raised and qi spread across the shoulders.

name: Illustrious Bore
description: Thrust upward and forward at the opponent's collar with the blade climbing as the arm extends.

name: Ruinous Stiffblade
description: Move forward in long even paces as a cloud crosses the sky, the point never wavering.

name: Straitgift
description: Read the opponent's whole stance against the sky and see which side is leaning on its guard.

name: Slenderpledge
description: Lock the opposing blade high and wide, leaving the opponent's whole body open below it.

name: Illustrious Pierce
description: Drop the point from a high bind straight down into the exposed chest.

name: Windborne Hardtip
description: Slip aside as a cloud slides from the sun, leaving the opponent's thrust to meet only light.

name: Imperial Trianglespine
description: Drive qi through the whole blade and break the opponent's guard open like cloud before a gale.

name: Bedrock Skewer
description: Rain a steady fall of thrusts from above that gives the opponent no breath to step forward.

name: Pierceboon
description: Vanish into the azure and reappear at the opponent's side with the point already thrusting.

name: Peerless Prism Bore
description: Draw one line of qi from the horizon to the point and thrust along it as the school's final stroke.

name: Devout Squarepoint
description: Sit the weight at the lower belly and hold the point level from the centre of the body.

name: Matchless Drill
description: Feed a pulse of qi from the belly up the arm as the thrust leaves the guard.

name: Spectral Gouge
description: Sway from the centre in a short curve that carries the body and point round the opponent's guard.

name: Deluge Stiffspine
description: Trace a small ring with the blade to carry a strike away from the body's centre.

name: Straitbenison
description: Feel the rhythm of the opponent's qi pulse through their blade and time the thrust between beats.

name: Thrallstrait
description: Lock the opposing blade with qi pressed outward from the core until the wrist locks too.

name: Straitedict
description: Drive the thrust from the belly through hips and shoulder so the whole body is one rod behind the point.

name: Nightmare Bore
description: Draw the qi inward so the thrust seems weak, then release it as the opponent steps to meet it.

name: Vacuum Squaretip
description: Concentrate the core's qi at the tip and rend open a plate's seam with one strong thrust.

name: Prismslender
description: Turn the blade in a ring around the core's qi and throw the opposing blow back at its source.

name: Gallant Impale
description: Send the core's qi through the point so the wound lands as though no armor were worn.

name: Triumphant Stiffspine
description: Gather the settled core's whole strength into one thrust, the school's final doctrine in a single stroke.

name: Sundering Rigidtang
description: Stand on firm ground with the oath spoken and the point levelled, ready to bear the opponent's rush.

name: Pulsar Bracespine
description: Thrust at the chest along a straight line sworn before the first step is taken.

name: Squall Drill
description: Pace out the oath across level ground, one measured stride for each line spoken.

name: Slendermercy
description: Read the opponent's stance from the wind that carries their scent and breath toward you.

name: Sigil Impale
description: Hold the opposing blade with a pressure that blows steady as a plateau wind.

name: Pulsartaut
description: Thrust at the opponent's lead side so they must turn toward the plateau's rim.

name: Squall Stiffblade
description: Sidestep on a gust as the opponent thrusts and return the point along the sworn line.

name: Magnificent Rigidtang
description: Charge on a rising gust of qi with the oath in the chest and the point leading through the guard.

name: Revelation Hardtip
description: Stand on the oath and turn the opponent's blow back along its own line with the gale's force.

name: Season Bracespine
description: Cross the plateau on a gale of qi and arrive with the point already lodged in the opponent's guard.

name: Steel Longtang
description: Speak the last oath into the blade and loose it as one thrust, the school's closing stroke.

name: Statute Squarepoint
description: Hold the blade level at the plateau's rim with the back to the open air and the point on the foe.

name: Triumphant Thrustspine
description: Thrust at the opponent's shoulder to turn them toward the rim and the long fall beyond.

name: Deluge Gouge
description: Pace along the rim in short even steps and keep the opponent between you and the drop.

name: Pealslender
description: Feel the updraft at the rim and read from it where the opponent's weight leans.

name: Longtang Reliquary
description: Bind the opponent's blade and walk them one step back at a time toward the open edge.

name: Pall Skewer
description: Show the open edge to the opponent, then thrust when they glance toward it.

name: Straitbanner
description: Split the guard with a thrust whose qi spreads outward from the point like a crack spreading in stone.

name: Matchless Pierce
description: Press the opponent toward the rim with unbroken thrusts that give no room to turn aside.

name: Demolition Trianglespine
description: Thrust with the open drop at one's back as a vow and pass through armor as though it were absent.

name: Royal Prism Drill
description: Carry the rim's whole wind into the last thrust that the school teaches as pressing a foe against the sky.

name: Enshrined Thrustspine
description: Face the opponent on open ground with no cover and the point levelled at the centre line.

name: Prismstrait
description: Lead the exchange with a long thrust that reaches across the opponent's whole front.

name: Windborne Impale
description: Take a long level step across open ground that closes distance without lifting the point.

name: Peal Rigidtang
description: Turn the flat of the blade against the opponent's strike and let it skate away like wind over grass.

name: Bountiful Hardtip
description: Read the whole open field for second opponents and the gaps between them.

name: Authoritative Bracespine
description: Cross blades in the open and bear down with steady qi until the opposing arm tires.

name: Vacuum Pierce
description: Thrust with the wind at the back so the point arrives with a gust's extra speed.

name: Vigor Squaretip
description: Slip to the opponent's open side in one quick step and leave their thrust passing behind.

name: Vacuum Stiffspine
description: Charge across the open ground with qi massed in the blade and break the guard it meets.

name: Season Stiffblade
description: Keep a gale of thrusts blowing across the opponent's front so they dare not attack.

name: Skewer Grace
description: Pass across the open ground in a single blur of qi and strike as the opponent turns.

name: Pulsar Trianglespine
description: Gather the open plateau's wind into a single closing thrust that the school teaches as its master stroke.

name: Steelstrait
description: Set the blade on a bearing taken from the wind and keep it unchanged against any approach.

name: Thunderclap Stiffspine
description: Thrust along the bearing without a single degree of deviation, however the opponent moves.

name: Tautvoyage
description: Walk forward along the bearing in even steps while the point stays pinned to the opponent's centre.

name: Lifegiving Squarepoint
description: Judge from the wind where the opponent stands and take the true bearing to them.

name: Millstone Bracespine
description: Lock the opposing blade across your bearing so the opponent's point cannot leave its line.

name: Steel Bore
description: Drive the thrust down the bearing with a push from the back leg and a snap of the wrist.

name: Bedrock Trianglespine
description: Step off the opponent's line and retake the bearing from the new position within a single breath.

name: Steel Rigidtang
description: Lunge along the bearing with a gust of qi lending reach that the opponent had not measured.

name: Phantasm Squaretip
description: Hold the bearing against the opponent's strike and send its force back along the same line.

name: Demolition Squarepoint
description: Send the point down an unswerving bearing so true that no plate turns it from the flesh beneath.

name: Radiance Longtang
description: Take one last bearing from the gale and thrust along it, the stroke the school teaches as its close.

name: Straittroth
description: Stand open to the wind with the blade level and the arm relaxed, ready to bend with any push.

name: Radiance Pierce
description: Thrust as freely as the wind runs, with no hitch between the draw and the arrival.

name: Vigor Impale
description: Move in loose, flowing paces that follow the shifting wind and never plant for long.

name: Deluge Hardtip
description: Let the opponent's blow slide off the blade like wind off a rock and keep the point where it was.

name: Magnanimous Thrustspine
description: Read the opponent's breath and heartbeat in the moving air about the blade.

name: Skewerpledge
description: Hold the opposing blade lightly and let it exhaust its own pushing against the yielding steel.

name: Majestic Stiffblade
description: Enter the opponent's guard on a gust of qi as a wind enters an unlatched door.

name: Soundless Bore
description: Slip to the windward side of the opponent and strike from where they cannot easily turn.

name: Exalted Trianglespine
description: Charge on a free-running wind of qi with the point leading and nothing held back.

name: Volition Stiffblade
description: Send thrusts after the opponent like a steady wind that leans on them and never rests.

name: Seasonimpale
description: Pass through the opponent's reach on a loosed wind and leave the point in the gap behind.

name: Vaunted Steel Drill
description: Loose the whole wind along the length of the blade in one final thrust, the school's closing stroke.

name: Tautpledge
description: Root the stance in the lower belly and hold the point levelled as an oath held in the chest.

name: Pulsar Skewer
description: Thrust from the core's centre along a line sworn before the exchange began.

name: Slendersolace
description: Pace forward with the weight rooted in the core and the point never rising or falling.

name: Tautbenison
description: Sense the opponent's resolve through the touch of steel and judge when it will break.

name: Thrall Gouge
description: Lock the opposing blade with qi pushed outward from the core until it can no longer turn.

name: Storied Thrustspine
description: Drive the thrust from the belly through the hips so that the whole body backs the point.

name: Piercebanner
description: Charge on the core's full breath with the oath spoken and the point leading the body.

name: Slendervow
description: Hold the blade across the line of the oath with qi from the core so no blow passes.

name: Vacuum Drill
description: Break through armor with qi drawn from the core and sworn to the line of the thrust.

name: Matchless Pulsar Pierce
description: Swear the whole core into one thrust, the school's last teaching in a single stroke.
